basis: The independent visual notes explicitly state that in 2014, the 0-14 years share is 14.82% and the 65 years + share is 20.1%. Since 20.1% > 14.82%, the 65 years + group has the larger 2014 share. Therefore, the public services planning follow-up record for the 65 years + group must be opened.
option_label: Open 2014 65 years + aging-services planning follow-up record
